p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/APPLE_2018_10K_reconstructed.json'

print(type(data))
print(data.keys())
print('texts', len(data.get('texts',[])))
for i,t in enumerate(data.get('texts',[])[:40]):
    txt=t.get('text','')

        print(i, t.get('page_no'), t.get('label'), txt[:250].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"
